## Tier header

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | **T3** |
| **Why** | Coach package editor validation and copy for the owner's price rule (paid packages start at $19.99, or free). It mirrors a backend API contract change. |
| **T4 trigger scan** | Payments money movement: NO. Auth/storage/native config: NO. CI gate files: NO. |
| **T3 trigger scan** | User-facing copy + validation + error handling on a payments screen: YES. Round 4: publish / unpublish controls and billing edits: YES. Round 5: removes the unsaved Trial days / Features inputs, gates Publish on unsaved edits, plain `PACKAGE_INVALID` copy, read-only weekly billing: YES. Round 6: recurring price copy states the $19.99 minimum and never offers $0; `.gitignore` / Git index hygiene (untracks a committed `node_modules` symlink; the vendor-name guard itself is unchanged): YES. Sentry reporting of unknown save failures (sanitised: event name, mode, status, machine code, reference only): YES. Depends on backend error codes from BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend#629. |
| **Bounded T1** | None. |
| **Builder-owner** | Builder lane B-FEE (S-FEE PR 2, mobile half); round 3 by lane B-FEE-R3; round 5 by lane B-FEE-R5; round 6 by lane B-FEE-R6. |
| **Acceptance evidence** | `src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts`, new `src/utils/__tests__/packageSaveFailure.test.ts`, S-FEE and save-failure blocks in `src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx` (real screen), round 6 `src/__tests__/repoHygiene.test.ts`. CI at head. |
| **Promotion triggers** | Promote to T4 if this starts changing checkout or payment amounts. |

## What changes

- New `src/utils/packagePrice.ts`: `PAID_PACKAGE_MIN_CENTS = 1999` (mirrors the backend) and `packagePriceIssue(cents, billingInterval, saved)` (round 3: `saved` is the saved price and interval).
- `CoachPackageEditScreen`:
  - Under the price field, always visible: "Paid packages start at $19.99, or make it free." The line switches to the error color when the price typed is under $19.99, or is $0 on a recurring package ("Free packages are one-time. Switch billing to One-time, or set a price of $19.99 or more.").
  - Save is blocked with the same copy. The old $0 message pointed coaches to invite codes; it is replaced, because $0 one-time packages are now allowed.
  - If a package was saved under $19.99 before this rule, it can still be edited while its price stays the same. This matches the backend, which never rewrites existing packages.
  - The backend codes `PACKAGE_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM`, `PACKAGE_RECURRING_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM` and `PACKAGE_FREE_MUST_BE_ONE_TIME` show the server's specific message in a "Check the price" alert, not the generic "Could not save".
- Copy has no emojis and no exclamation marks.

### Round 3 (Sol B-321-1, C-321-1)

- New `src/utils/packageSaveFailure.ts`: `describePackageSaveFailure(err, 'create' | 'update')`. It reads the HTTP status and the backend machine code (`code`, then `error`, via `toAuthErrorDetail`; before this round the screen read `error` only). Every failure says what happened, that the edits are still on screen, and offers a working next action:

| Failure | Title | Next action (dialog button) |
|---|---|---|
| No answer (offline) | No connection | Try again |
| Timeout (`ECONNABORTED`) | The server took too long | Try again |
| 401 | Please sign in again | Sign in |
| 403 `SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE` / `SUBSCRIPTION_PAST_DUE_GRACE_EXPIRED` / `TIER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED` | Your plan is not active | Open billing |
| other 403 | You cannot edit this package | Back to packages |
| 404 / `PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND` | Package not found | Back to packages |
| `PACKAGE_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM`, `PACKAGE_RECURRING_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM`, `PACKAGE_FREE_MUST_BE_ONE_TIME` | Check the price (server's floor copy, owner copy as fallback) | Fix the price |
| `PACKAGE_PRICING_LOCKED` | Pricing is locked | Create a new package (copy) |
| `PACKAGE_ARCHIVED` | This package is archived | Back to packages |
| `PACKAGES_NOT_CONFIGURED` | Packages are not available yet | Back to packages, Contact support |
| 400 / `PACKAGE_INVALID` | Check the package details (server message) | Fix the field |
| 429 | Too many saves | Wait a minute |
| 5xx / unknown | Could not save the package | Try again, Contact support (SupportInbox), and quote reference XXXXXXXX |

- Unknown failures show a short reference: the server's `request_id` (body, then the `x-request-id` header), else the id this app sent, else a local id. They are reported to Sentry under the same full reference as `package_save_<mode>_failed` with `{flow, mode, status, code, reference}` only, never the body, prices, headers or tokens. Known failures are not reported.
- The message also stays inline under the form, so the reference is still visible after the dialog closes. Try again re-runs the save with the current form.
- Archive failures no longer fall back to "Please try again." alone.
- C-321-1: `packagePriceIssue(cents, interval, saved)` now takes the saved price configuration. A price saved under $19.99 keeps working only while both the price and the billing interval are unchanged. A new interval at the old price must meet the floor. This matches backend #629 C-629-1.

### Round 5 (Opus 0/2/4 at 4295fc79)
- B-321-4: the Trial days and Features inputs are removed, together with their part of the buyer preview. The backend stores neither and checkout has no package trial. Every input left on the screen (name, description, price, billing) reaches the request body. The fallback copy no longer mentions trial days.
- B-321-5: while the form differs from the saved package, Publish is disabled and the screen says "Save your changes before you publish." After Save it publishes the saved row, which is exactly what the screen shows.
- C-321-3 (with backend Sol C-629-4): the backend's `PACKAGE_INVALID` text is never shown. The field it is about picks plain app copy: name, price ("Enter the price in dollars and cents, for example 19.99, or 0 to make it free"), billing ("Choose how clients pay: One-time, Monthly, Quarterly or Yearly"), currency (contact support) or description. Anything else gets the plain fallback. The $19.99-minimum-or-free messages (`PACKAGE_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM`, `PACKAGE_RECURRING_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM`, `PACKAGE_FREE_MUST_BE_ONE_TIME`) still show backend #629's own coach copy, and the inline rule is unchanged: 1999 cents or more, or exactly 0 on one-time.
- C-321-4: failure titles name the action: "Could not create / save / publish / unpublish the package"; a publish 429 says "Too many tries".
- C-321-5: a weekly backend package reads as Weekly (list "/ wk", buyer "per week"). The editor shows "Billed weekly. Leave this as it is to keep weekly billing, or pick another option to change it." Saving other fields keeps it weekly. Weekly is not offered as a new choice.
- C-321-6: the archived banner now reads "This package is archived. It cannot be sold or changed. Create a new package instead. Current clients keep their access."

### Round 6 (Opus 0/1/1 and Sol 0/1/1 at 7322bbff, same two findings)
- B-321-6: the absolute `node_modules` symlink that a worktree had committed (mode 120000) is removed from the index, and `.gitignore` now ignores `node_modules` without the directory-only slash, so a symlink is ignored too. The vendor-name guard is not changed or weakened; it passes again.
- C-321-7: free packages are one-time only, so price copy follows the billing choice. One-time keeps "or 0 to make it free". Monthly, quarterly and yearly say "Recurring packages start at $19.99." in the inline helper, the inline price error, the `PACKAGE_INVALID` price message and the `PACKAGE_PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM` alert. Backend #627 sends the same sentence for a recurring package below the minimum.
- Merged mobile main `2c17c241` with a merge commit (clean).

## Dependencies

- Backend: BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend#629 (validation and error codes). Free-package claiming comes from backend #595. Recommended merge order: #595, then BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend#629, then this PR.

## Tests

Round 6 (at 1413edb, through heavy.sh): `env CI=true npx jest --runInBand src/__tests__/repoHygiene.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/packageSaveFailure.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx`: 4 suites, 56/56 passed. Failing-before: the same suites on the round-5 source (`git checkout 7322bbf -- src/utils/packagePrice.ts src/utils/packageSaveFailure.ts src/screens/coach/payments/CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx`) fail 8 and pass 45. `node scripts/vendor-name-guard.mjs`: passed (it failed with EISDIR at 7322bbff). eslint on the changed files: 0 errors (1 old warning).

Round 5 (at 7322bbf, through heavy.sh): `env CI=true npx jest --runInBand --ci src/utils/__tests__/packageSaveFailure.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx src/__tests__/PackageDetailSurface.preview.test.tsx src/__tests__/PackageCheckoutScreen.buyer.test.tsx src/api/__tests__/packagesBackendContract.test.ts`: 6 suites passed (screen + contract re-run 48/48 after one test-helper fix; save-failure re-run after a type fix). `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3584 npx tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors. eslint on the 7 changed files: 0 errors (2 old unused `tokens` warnings in style factories).

Round 3: `npx jest --runInBand src/utils/__tests__/packageSaveFailure.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx`: 3 suites, 34 tests passed. `npx tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors. eslint on changed files: 0 errors (1 pre-existing unused-arg warning, `tokens` in the styles factory).

Round 0: `npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/utils/__tests__/packagePrice.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.lockPreview.test.tsx`: 2 suites, 15 tests passed. `npx tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors. eslint on changed files: 0 errors (1 pre-existing unused-arg warning).

## Fix round

Unknown failures get a reference (request_id), Contact support and a sanitised Sentry event. Inline copy is kept. | a9b1f49d | Screen: "500 with request_id: reference, Try again, Contact support, Sentry event under the same reference" (request_id `sol321-reference` → `SOL321RE`), "network error ... offers Try again, no Sentry noise", timeout, 401 Sign in, 403 Open billing, 404 Back to packages, "reads the machine `code`", "never shows a generic message" ×4. Unit: `packageSaveFailure.test.ts` (19-case table, reference order, privacy) |
| C-321-1 (Sol) grandfather scope | `packagePriceIssue` takes the saved price and interval. A changed interval at a sub-floor price hits the floor. | a9b1f49d | `packagePrice.test.ts` "C-321-1: a new billing interval at the old price is a new price"; screen "C-321-1: a package saved under $19.99 cannot change its billing interval" |
